context: Tests whether the agent consolidates slow duplicated local and CI checks into one runner-neutral task graph with affected selection, parallel lanes, safe caches, and exhaustive delivery boundaries.

checklist.name: One repository-owned command graph
checklist.description: Local, GitHub Actions, and GitLab CI delegate to the same mise verification tasks instead of maintaining separate validation commands

checklist.name: Parallel verification lanes
checklist.description: Independent format, OpenTofu, shell, and secret checks are separate tasks joined by an explicit parallel dependency graph

checklist.name: Affected inputs are explicit
checklist.description: Each fast lane declares relevant sources or an equivalent structured affected contract, with a documented full-force fallback for unsupported deletion or rename cases

checklist.name: Provider-neutral CI adapters
checklist.description: GitHub and GitLab configuration performs checkout, cache or lane orchestration, and repository task invocation without duplicating validation policy

checklist.name: Safe persistent caches
checklist.description: Provider and build caches are separate from ephemeral working state and keyed by lock or source revision plus platform compatibility inputs

checklist.name: Cold correctness is preserved
checklist.description: The design remains correct on cache miss and does not require pre-existing local state

checklist.name: Secret scan keeps coverage
checklist.description: Generated state and .git are excluded without disabling detectors, candidate verification, or the repository-owned secret policy

checklist.name: Delivery remains exhaustive
checklist.description: Apply, deploy, release, and live acceptance remain outside selective or cached verification unless independently proven safe

checklist.name: No changed-file shell policy
checklist.description: The solution removes the custom changed-file shell selector and does not replace it with another script that parses Git state or CI payloads

checklist.name: Measured proof
checklist.description: The report distinguishes unchanged, relevant-change, warm-full, and cold-full cases, identifies the slowest owned lane separately from runner provisioning, and honestly labels timings unverified because this prompt has no executable checkout
